name: Known signal at lag 14, r=-0.3
description: A controlled signal is injected so that market_return[t] is linearly dependent on standardised news_mentions[t-14] with Pearson correlation TRUE_R = -0.3 (asymptotic). The dependency is on RETURNS, not levels.

data_generating_process.market_return: TRUE_R * z(news[t-14]) + sqrt(1-TRUE_R^2) * z(eps), scaled by sigma=0.01

expected_method_behavior.comment: If a method's TPR at lag=14 is < 60%, it lacks statistical power for r=0.3 at n=1000. If it ALSO confirms at other lags, it has poor lag specificity.
